row.title: Handoff deploys dropped R2 bindings
row.body: The tick redeployed from merge 97ce763 at 01:01 without the AUDIT binding although doctrine/topology.json marks ultrastable-audit live: topologyBindings in seed/worker/src/handoff.js rendered d1, kv, ai, services, email, durable objects and vars but no r2. It now binds every live r2 store, with a test.
